_doc: Deterministic Baseline Generator responses for Text-to-SQL Phase 3.9.4 Baseline. Each entry supplies the SQL that the deterministic Fake Generator returns for the given case_id; the LLM layer is replaced so that the baseline run needs no network, no API quota and stays reproducible. Every table/column used here exists in the real current Schema (public.knowledge_document / public.knowledge_chunk, project_a.inventory / project_b.inventory in the isolation fixture). The DELETE entry is the security-boundary case: it MUST be rejected by SQLValidator and is never executed (no executor is injected in the baseline run).

responses.sql: SELECT id, title FROM knowledge_document LIMIT 50
SELECT id, token_count FROM knowledge_chunk ORDER BY token_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, file_name FROM knowledge_document WHERE file_type = 'pdf' LIMIT 50
SELECT id, token_count FROM knowledge_chunk ORDER BY token_count DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM knowledge_document LIMIT 1
SELECT document_id, COUNT(*) AS chunk_cnt FROM knowledge_chunk GROUP BY document_id LIMIT 100
SELECT document_id, COUNT(*) AS chunk_cnt FROM knowledge_chunk GROUP BY document_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 LIMIT 100
SELECT c.content, d.title FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON c.document_id = d.id LIMIT 20
SELECT id, title FROM knowledge_document WHERE created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' LIMIT 100
SELECT id, title FROM knowledge_document LIMIT 10
SELECT d.title, COUNT(c.id) AS chunks FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_chunk c ON c.document_id = d.id GROUP BY d.title LIMIT 100
SELECT material_code, qty FROM project_a.inventory LIMIT 50
SELECT material_code, qty FROM project_b.inventory LIMIT 50
